intro.text: ALT5 Sigma Corporation (formerly known as JanOne Inc.) and subsidiaries (collectively, “we,” “us,” the “Company,” or “ALT5”). Through our Fintech segment, the Company provides next-generation blockchain-powered technologies for digital asset trading, payments processing and related payment card services. On May 15, 2024, the Company acquired ALT5 Sigma, Inc., and on July 15, 2024, changed its corporate name from JanOne Inc. to ALT5 Sigma Corporation. ALT5 Sigma, Inc., is a financial services and Fintech holding company. ALT5 Sigma, Inc. was created by financial industry specialists to provide the digital asset economy with the best practices of the industry and state of the art over-the-counter trading.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: To the extent natural disasters or catastrophic events concurrently impact data centers we rely on in connection with private key restoration, customers will experience significant delays in withdrawing funds, or in the extreme, we may suffer loss of customer funds.

In view of the rapidly evolving nature of our business and the crypto-economy, period-to-period comparisons of our operating results may not be meaningful, and you should not rely upon them as an indication of future performance.
Any such events affecting a blockchain network we rely upon could result in loss of assets, platform disruption, reputational harm, and financial loss to our customers and to us.
Our ability to mitigate these risks depends on our fraud detection and prevention capabilities, compliance with card network rules, and the effectiveness of our KYC and authentication procedures.

Governments, regulatory bodies, and investors are increasingly focused on climate-related risks, energy usage, and sustainability considerations associated with digital asset networks, particularly those that rely on energy-intensive consensus mechanisms.

Our reputation and ability to attract and retain customers and grow our business depends on our ability to operate our service at high levels of reliability, scalability, and performance, including the ability to process and monitor, on a daily basis, a large number of transactions that occur at high volume and frequencies across multiple systems.
Our success depends on our ability to retain existing customers and attract new customers, including developers, to increase engagement with our products, services, and platform.
Our risk management policies and procedures rely on a combination of technical and human controls and supervision that are subject to error and failure.
Our future success depends on our ability to attract, develop, motivate, and retain highly qualified and skilled employees.

The price at which our common stock trades depends upon a number of factors, including our historical and anticipated operating results, our financial situation, announcements of technological innovations or new products by us, our ability or inability to raise additional capital we may need and the terms on which we raise it, and general market and economic conditions.
